# Committee Introduction

We are Minnetonka residents working together to support a 6% cap on annual City of Minnetonka property tax levy increases. 
We welcome residents who want to learn more, volunteer, or help with the initiative.

# Committee Members

## Kelly Chermack - President

## Tom Stockert - Secretary / Treasurer

Tom Stockert moved to Minnetonka in 2013 and is a retired Chief Financial Officer and active local volunteer. 
He helped found a Minnetonka habitat restoration nonprofit, where he serves on the board and volunteers. 
He also volunteers with a local animal rescue and pursues other volunteer activities. 
Keeping Minnetonka a great, affordable place to live is a passion for Tom.

## Robert (Bob) Falk

I would like to continue to live in Minnetonka.
I have had many activities related to community service.
